Points are individual training seeds; intervals use training seeds only. Negative MMD estimates are retained. Standard FM uses same-checkpoint Heun. Partial groups are explicitly n/5.
Actual per-run training and primary-solver sampling wall-clock costs; mean and marginal 95% t intervals across training seeds. Same-checkpoint diagnostic cost is separate in raw tables.

Representative rule: lowest available training seed, first ensemble, first four particles; fixed saved real-reference block. Examples are illustrative, not paired prediction errors. Blue/red spans identify registered downstream input/output observation windows.

Saved evaluation arrays use correct [observation position, channel] axes. Bands are pointwise training-seed intervals, not simultaneous bands or particle-count intervals. Fixed real reference is not treated as repeated seed evidence.

Mean saved correlation matrix over available independent training seeds; coordinates map s*2+channel as exported. Multiscale has no invented deterministic residual target.

Existing evaluation metrics only: late re-pairing preserves marginal samples and breaks early/late dependence. Same-seed original versus shuffled numbers are retained; reference lines are fixed, not repeated independent seeds.

Read existing final ridge evaluation, never fit or select a new model. Lambda was selected only using shared real validation. TSTR intervals use independent generator training seeds; repeated fixed TRTR baselines have no seed-based uncertainty claim.

Raw 95% intervals over available paired training seeds, separate from Holm-adjusted tests in paired_comparisons.csv. Missing seed pairs are not imputed. An interval crossing zero does not prove equivalence.
